title: Bank letter - new debit card
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Synthetic test document. It follows the structure of the real document type but is not an actual letter from any organisation.
summary_en: The bank has mailed a new debit card that must be activated by phone before use; the old card stops working on October 15, 2026.
text:
Harbour Credit Union (fictional)
Your new debit card is enclosed.
Before using it, activate the card by calling 1-800-555-0160 from your home phone number. Your old card will stop working on October 15, 2026.
Never share your PIN. We will never call or text you to ask for it.
